conditions: Under docs/release-policy.md §3 as adopted by release-policy-public-1.1-amend-3 (sha256 a7b5def3c1fd5fa17b56eb4b205c8ee1a877ddcea85ccf76a71e7c4341b607d6), mathAgents' toolchain.lock leaves the researchteam 1.2 line for the 1.3 line: the researchteam pin may move to a verified, signed, final (not pre-release) researchteam v1.3.N tag, its peeled 40-hex commit, by the pin-move PR on main that release/1.3 is then cut from. Each such move still needs everything else §3 requires (S-9 tag verification, the vulnerability search, the latest-stable rule, the @security review and its row) and the operator's merge approval at a fixed head. It does not cover a pin to any other line, it does not lift the S-10 cooldown for a non-member, and it does not authorize the render, which needs its own signed overwrite rows. It does not cover a pin-move PR that changes .github/agentteams-autosync-ref (only the autosync gate writes that file); such a PR needs its own release-line row targeting toolchain.lock and .github/agentteams-autosync-ref. It grants and relaxes nothing and takes no exception-registry slot.
